# Jack Fashion buying reference

> Official reference for African women's dresses and wholesale fashion apparel, with direct WhatsApp enquiries and order-specific confirmation.

## Business and contact
- Official website: https://zamique.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/message/3N5VOJCFAQIGO1
- Number: +86 189 2625 7367
- Additional WhatsApp: https://wa.me/message/YCF76Z5EEXJIF1 (+86 186 6505 5946)
- Wholesale base: Yulong Fashion Plaza, No. 229 Guangyuan Xi Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, China
- Additional wholesale showroom: Shop 0081, LIUHUA Market, Guangzhou, China
- Business model: Own factory, factory-direct wholesale and custom production.
- Product scope: Womenswear: dresses, sets, tops, pants and custom production.
- Sales team: Jack: +86 189 2625 7367; Amber: +86 186 6505 5946.

Jack Fashion is a Guangzhou women's clothing manufacturer and wholesale supplier with its own factory. Its catalog supports international enquiries from boutiques, wholesalers, importers and online retailers, including buyers sourcing for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania and South Africa.
A broad ready-stock selection alongside custom production; confirm quantities by style and batch.

## Product lines
The catalog currently lists 138 wholesale styles. MOQ requires confirmation for each style.
Product categories: Coordinated Styles, Plus Size Dresses, Two Piece Sets, Maxi Dresses, Jumpsuits, Midi Dresses, Mini Dresses.
- [Women’s jumpsuits wholesale from Guangzhou](https://zamique.com/wholesale/jumpsuits): Printed one-piece styles, torso and inseam measurements, stock enquiries and custom fit checks.
- [Maxi dresses wholesale from Guangzhou](https://zamique.com/wholesale/maxi-dresses): Long dress style codes, finished measurements, stock enquiries and custom order checks.
- [African dresses wholesale](https://zamique.com/wholesale/african-dresses): Dress sourcing for African boutiques and wholesalers.
- [Two piece sets wholesale supplier](https://zamique.com/wholesale/two-piece-sets): Matching top-and-bottom styles, separate component measurements, and batch mix checks.
- [Wholesale plus size dresses from China](https://zamique.com/wholesale/plus-size-womens-clothing): Plus size dresses from Guangzhou with flat tape measurements and curve fit grading.
- [Stock enquiries](https://zamique.com/wholesale/ready-stock): Check current stock for selected styles before placing an order.

## MOQ and bulk quotation
MOQ requires confirmation for each style. Send the style code or product link, quantity per style, size-color breakdown and destination city to request a wholesale quotation. Product prices and availability require confirmation; this catalog is not a fixed-price stock offer.

## Custom orders and manufacturing enquiries
Send reference images or sample details, garment measurements, material requirements, quantity and target delivery date for a feasibility check. Confirm available OEM/ODM services, sampling, approved specifications, production lead time and quality checks for the selected design before ordering. Production capacity and any required certifications should be confirmed for the actual order.
- [Custom order enquiries](https://zamique.com/custom-orders)
- [Stock and custom order checks](https://zamique.com/guides/ready-stock-custom-orders)

## Shipping, customs and payment terms
Freight, packing, cargo handover, insurance, shipping terms, export documents, import clearance, duties and importer responsibilities must be agreed for each order and destination. Confirm the nominated forwarder or cargo agent, receiving details and payment beneficiary before paying. No universal Incoterm, duty-paid service or transit time is promised.
- [Packing and cargo handover checklist](https://zamique.com/guides/packing-cargo-handover)
- [Terms](https://zamique.com/terms)

## Measurements and product confirmation
Size labels vary by design and should not be treated as automatic US, EU or other local conversions. Confirm finished garment measurements and the method used. Garment construction, pieces included, material, fit, live stock and prices must be confirmed for the selected product and order. Illustrative allocation tables are examples, not stock offers.

Images cannot substantiate live stock, factory ownership, fabric properties, measured sizes, certifications or delivery history. Request current product photos or video and a written quotation.
